name: PROP-FP
about: PROP-FP (1988-059, MOM), launched 1988 Jul 12. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit to check it against (solved: perihelion 1.013 au, aphelion 1.591 au)
